title: Note Event to PIS to fresh-Naya retrieval is runtime-proven
summary: A canonical Intelligence Event can be promoted, propagated into the PIS consumed by the memory runtime, retrieved by a fresh successor context, and propagated idempotently without creating duplicate notes.
what_happened: The existing Promotion Engine produced the event representations and feed state. A deterministic PIS propagation boundary was added and an isolated acceptance test proved Note Event → PIS → fresh-Naya retrieval → idempotent re-propagation.
what_we_learned: Promotion and PIS propagation are separate evidence transitions; promotion alone does not prove successor retrieval.
The canonical PIS must be the same memory authority consumed by fresh-Naya restore/retrieval, otherwise A→B→C can pass while real continuity remains disconnected.
Propagation must refuse conflicting canonical notes rather than overwrite them.
Propagation must be idempotent so repeated execution cannot duplicate memory or drift the index.
why_it_matters: This closes the architectural gap between an intelligence event existing in the Promotion Engine path and that intelligence actually becoming retrievable by a successor Naya.
what_changed: Added tools/propagate_intelligence_to_pis.py as a deterministic Note Event → PIS transition.
Added tools/test_superbrain_note_event_to_pis.py as an end-to-end acceptance proof.
Made the PIS acceptance test mandatory in tools/run_superbrain_local_suite.py.
next_best_action: Perform the human fresh-Naya behavioral acceptance: new conversation, restore NayaPOWER without copied history, then authorize one safe continuation and observe whether the Naya selects the current frontier, verifies its work, captures learning, and leaves a successor-ready torch.
evidence: Fresh-Naya live behavioral acceptance remains human-observation evidence and is not claimed here.
